name: io.github.Xquik-dev/tweetclaw
description: Search tweets, search replies, post tweets, export followers, manage media, monitor X/Twitter, and run giveaway draws through Xquik. Includes 33 prepaid paid-read routes and 7 direct MPP routes. OpenClaw plugin with 99 agent-callable endpoints via 2 tools (explore + tweetclaw). Not affiliated with X Corp.
